hero.title: Organize your inbox with Claude
hero.text: Claude looks at who writes to you and suggests a label for each sender. You review it and nothing changes until you accept.

read.title: Claude reads
read.text: Only the name, sender and subject, never the content of your messages.

decide.title: You decide
decide.text: Remove senders, rename labels and choose what happens to new mail.

auto.title: Gmail does the rest
auto.text: The filters sort your mail all day, even with this computer off.
